summary: Iteration 6: All new features tested and working. CRM Outstanding shows proper aging columns (0-30, 30-60, 60-90, 90+ days) with real invoice date calculations. Status based on oldest_invoice_days (Normal/At Risk/Overdue/Critical). Customer group filter works. Sales voucher numbers are clickable and open invoice modal with full details. Followups show created_by_name.
passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/customers/outstanding returns aging_0_30, aging_30_60, aging_60_90, aging_90_plus fields
Backend: GET /api/customers/outstanding returns status based on oldest_invoice_days (not mocked 30%)
Backend: GET /api/customers/outstanding returns ledger_group (customer group) field
Backend: GET /api/customers/outstanding - outstanding = total_sales when no Tally closing balance
Backend: GET /api/sales/vouchers/{id} returns full voucher with items, subtotal, computed_total
Backend: GET /api/sales/vouchers/{id} returns line items with item name, quantity, rate
Backend: GET /api/sales/vouchers/{id} returns salesman field
Backend: GET /api/sales/vouchers/{id} returns reference_number field
Backend: GET /api/sales/vouchers/NONEXISTENT returns success=false with 'not found' error
Backend: GET /api/customers/followups returns created_by_name field
Backend: GET /api/sales/vouchers returns list of vouchers with count
Frontend: Sales page voucher numbers are clickable (green links)
Frontend: Clicking voucher opens InvoiceModal with voucher ID, customer, date, reference, salesman
Frontend: InvoiceModal shows line items table with #, Item, Qty, Rate, Amount columns
Frontend: InvoiceModal shows total amount
Frontend: CRM Outstanding tab shows aging columns: 0-30 Days, 30-60 Days, 60-90 Days, 90+ Days
Frontend: CRM Outstanding tab shows Group column
Frontend: CRM Outstanding tab shows Status column with Critical/Overdue/Normal badges
Frontend: CRM Outstanding has customer group filter dropdown
Frontend: CRM Follow-ups tab shows 'by Administrator' for followups with created_by_name
seed_data_creation: Using existing demo data from previous iterations. Sales vouchers from January 2026 show proper aging (60-90 and 90+ day buckets).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 6 added: 1) CRM Outstanding with real aging calculation from invoice dates (not mocked 30%), 2) Status based on oldest_invoice_days (Normal <30, At Risk 30-60, Overdue 60-90, Critical 90+), 3) Customer group filter on CRM Outstanding, 4) Sales voucher detail endpoint /api/sales/vouchers/{id}, 5) InvoiceModal component in Sales page for viewing invoice details. All features working correctly.

crm_outstanding_aging.aging_0_30: Shows amount for invoices 0-30 days old
crm_outstanding_aging.aging_30_60: Shows amount for invoices 30-60 days old
crm_outstanding_aging.aging_60_90: Shows amount for invoices 60-90 days old (orange text)
crm_outstanding_aging.aging_90_plus: Shows amount for invoices 90+ days old (red text)
crm_outstanding_aging.status_logic: Based on oldest_invoice_days: Normal (<30), At Risk (30-60), Overdue (60-90), Critical (90+)

customer_group_filter.dropdown: Shows 'All Customer Groups' and 'Sundry Debtors' options

sales_invoice_modal.trigger: Click voucher number in Sales table
